feedback: The geometry changes—larger sensors, forward-shifted sensor positions, and wider wheel track—should help reduce line loss events and steering oscillations by improving line detection robustness and robot stability. The previous race telemetry showed early line loss and moderate steering oscillation, which I compensated for by lowering base speed and PID gains to smooth control. The sensor weights remain proportional to sensor positions, supporting effective error correction. For next iterations, I recommend trying: 1) Further fine-tuning PID gains to balance responsiveness and smoothness as telemetry arrives. 2) Testing slight variations in sensor y-positions forward or backward by ±0.005 to optimize line anticipation. 3) Considering a small increase in base speed if control smoothness improves, to enhance progress and completion.
